description: Curated authority map for Incremental (漂流コロニー), verified against the real code and tests. The map only POINTS at authorities — it is not one. `kinds`: code = canonical implementation, spec = design authority (GDD), test = regression enforcement. ./dev authority --check verifies every listed path exists.

authorities.title: Save state schema + tuning constants
authorities.notes: SAVE_KEY, RESOURCE_KEYS, BUILDING_KEYS, PRESTIGE_UPGRADE_KEYS, FOOD_PER_SURVIVOR, STARTING_FOOD, BASE_POPULATION_CAP, MAX_CARRY_SURVIVORS, OFFLINE_* all live here. New top-level state keys MUST be added here AND handled by normalizeState — the codec field count is derived from these lists.

authorities.title: Building defs / milestones / unlock conditions / costs
authorities.validation: tests/regression.test.js (milestone matrix, unlock chain, no-literal-duplication in ui.js)
authorities.notes: BUILDING_DEFS is the single source of truth. Milestone multipliers 1.15/1.33/1.60 are CALIBRATED (comment: first jump 27-30min, components-500 gap <=8min) — do not retune casually. The regression test asserts the literals never appear in src/ui.js — never inline them.

authorities.title: tick() production/consumption/power/food engine
authorities.validation: tests/regression.test.js (milestone production, consumption exemption, power supply/demand)
authorities.notes: Power is an instantaneous flow, not a stored resource — supply<demand proportionally throttles consumers. Milestone multiplies OUTPUT only, never consumption. Food penalty is a binary threshold (<=0 → ×0.5), not graduated. getBuildingOutputMultiplier is the shared authority — call it, don't reimplement.

authorities.title: Survivor population + assignment
authorities.validation: tests/regression.test.js (via farm unlock + decode invariant); ./dev save-check (assigned>total reset)
authorities.notes: Pop cap = BASE_POPULATION_CAP + prestige.upgrades.populationCap (state.js constants). decodeSaveCode resets assignments if assigned total exceeds total — preserve that invariant.

authorities.title: Escape requirements / planet jump reset / knowledge economy
authorities.validation: tests/regression.test.js (bottleneck progress ratio, reset to ×1 multipliers, no literal dup in ui.js)
authorities.notes: ESCAPE_REQUIREMENTS {components:500, metal:800} is the only source — the test forbids the literals in ui.js. Progress display = min(bottleneck ratio). KP = floor(sqrt((components*2+metal)/40)). Carry limit MAX_CARRY_SURVIVORS=3 lives in state.js.

authorities.title: Achievement definitions + unlock checks
authorities.validation: tests/regression.test.js (checkAchievements stubbed; DOM test asserts log path)
authorities.notes: Achievements + stats are localStorage-only — deliberately EXCLUDED from the save code (GDD §7/§9 hybrid spec). Do not add them to the codec.

authorities.title: Save persistence — localStorage, normalizeState, save-code codec, offline progress
authorities.validation: tests/regression.test.js (normalizeState legacy test); ./dev save-check (codec roundtrip, checksum, version gate, offline caps)
authorities.notes: normalizeState shallow-merges each section over createInitialState — older saves gain new keys for free. Save-code field count IS the version gate (decodeSaveCode rejects wrong counts). checksum = last '_' + 4 base36 chars. Offline: <5s ignored, capped at OFFLINE_MAX_SECONDS=8h, 30s steps at OFFLINE_EFFICIENCY=0.5.

authorities.title: Next-goal guidance logic (priority semantics)
authorities.validation: tests/regression.test.js (unlock>all, jump-KP when able, milestone-vs-escape ratio comparison)
authorities.notes: QUIRK: goal logic lives in src/ui.js despite being game logic — goal kinds {unlock,milestone,escape,jump} and their priority order are regression-tested. If it moves files, keep the semantics.

authorities.title: DOM rendering + element IDs
authorities.validation: tests/regression.test.js (DOM stub render smoke; artifact ID-set equality)
authorities.notes: index.html element ids are the contract — the artifact sync test compares the id sets of index.html and artifact/game.html. Renaming an id requires touching both.

authorities.title: Boot + game loop + autosave cadence
authorities.notes: TICK_INTERVAL_MS=200 doubles as the render interval BY DESIGN (comment: full-DOM rebuild every frame caused lost clicks). dt clamp <5s guards background-tab jumps. AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL_MS=10s in state.js.

authorities.title: Self-contained artifact bundle
authorities.notes: artifact/game.html is GENERATED — never edit directly. index.html <script src> order is the load-order authority the builder consumes. The sync test compares normalized CSS+JS+ids.

authorities.title: Module load order
authorities.validation: tests/regression.test.js (ARTIFACT_ORDER joins the same files; sync test)
authorities.notes: tests/regression.test.js keeps a PARALLEL copy (SCRIPT_ORDER/ARTIFACT_ORDER) — divergence surfaces via the artifact-sync test but a mismatch in load-order could break the vm harness first. When adding a src file: index.html + SCRIPT_ORDER + artifact regen.

authorities.title: Pacing calibration
authorities.validation: manual play measurement (comment cites measured 27'47" first jump)
authorities.notes: GDD §2/§4/§6 is spec authority; the buildings.js comment records real-measured calibration targets. Changing growths/requirements is a balance change — out of scope for infra work.

authorities.title: Design spec
authorities.validation: code must conform; where code diverges the file comment + tests are the truth
authorities.notes: GDD documents intent incl. MVP simplifications (power flow, binary food penalty). Where spec and code disagree, check file comments — several simplifications are deliberate.
